name: ont-019-fixture-notes
description: e2e fixture for orangerail init on a Prisma SQLite source: a single Note model exercising the from-registry boot (init -> mcp -> governed write loop) after installing the packed tarballs into an out-of-repo prefix. Declares prisma + @prisma/client so the generated client can be built without a network install.
